tools.name: check_coin
tools.description: CON's public coin check for one Solana token (mint address): risk class, the dev wallet's earlier coins and exits, wallet rings, holder concentration, contract rights and findings, read against CON's record of every Solana launch since Oct 2026. Same data as centralonet.com/scan, no account.

tools.name: launch_index
tools.description: The CON Launch Index: per day, Solana coins rated by CON and the share that stood 70% or more lower one hour later, overall, per risk class and per finding. Without a date: the latest day and the last 14 days.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Two-sentence definition of a Solana memecoin market term (bundled launch, sniper, dev exit, bonding curve ...) or a CON system or capability name.

tools.name: rating_log
tools.description: State of CON's hash-chained public rating log: closing hash per day, entries, and how High ratings fared one hour later (misses included). With the link to the verify script.

tools.name: list_systems
tools.description: The six systems behind every CON check, one line each, with their pages.
